content: AI wrote me duplicate code for six months and I never noticed.

Agent 3 and Agent 5 built the exact same function.
Neither knew the other existed.

Three different date formatters.
Two config parsers.
Four ways to validate input.

Started deleting. The app didn't break.
It got faster.
Found a shell injection in my AI-generated code.

Line 847. AI wrote it. I approved it.
I don't read every line. That's the whole point of vibe coding.

Now I read every line.
That kind of defeats the purpose, doesn't it.
Day three of Google login. Works on web. Desktop crashes.

Asked AI why. AI doesn't know either.
We're both staring at the same error message.

This is the part of vibe coding nobody warns you about.
When it breaks, you can't debug what you can't read.
